GmailDock v0.3.0

### Settings in their own window
- Settings now open in a separate GmailDock window instead of a panel inside Gmail. Open it from the tray menu or run `gmaildock --settings`.
- Follows your system light/dark theme.
- New option: open non-Google links in your default browser (on by default).
- The global shortcut can be changed or turned off.
- Window size, position and maximized state are remembered.

### Updates
- GmailDock checks for updates in the background at startup and every 30 minutes.
- Choose "Skip this version" to stop being reminded about a release; you can undo it in Settings.
- Installing an update shows real download progress.

### Reliability
- Settings are saved atomically. A damaged settings file is kept as `settings.json.corrupt` instead of silently resetting your preferences.
- No more white flash on launch: the window appears once Gmail has loaded.
- Errors are written to a log file. Open it from the tray: Troubleshooting → Open logs folder.
- The unread count shows in the window title and the tray tooltip.
- New-mail notifications are limited to one per minute, and you get a notification when a download finishes.
- The tray menu adds Open in browser and Troubleshooting.

Note: Workspace SSO pages (Okta, Microsoft) now open in your browser by default. If you sign in through SSO, turn off "Open non-Google links in my browser" in Settings.

Windows is the currently tested platform. macOS and Linux users are invited to test and report issues.
